## Docs checklist

Tick what applies; leave the rest unticked.

- [ ] Added or changed a route → docs/SCREENS.md
- [ ] Added or changed an endpoint → docs/architecture/api-reference.md (regenerate)
- [ ] Changed a money, state or eligibility rule → spec updated + test added
- [ ] Added or changed a simulation → docs/status/integrations.md
- [ ] Changed an invariant or reversed a decision → ADR in docs/adr/
- [ ] Uploaded a build → build log in docs/runbooks/testflight-eas.md
- [ ] Ran tests worth citing → docs/quality/verification-log.md
- [ ] Learned a gotcha → one line in AGENTS.md
